value.title: We Challenge the Strongest!
value.synopsis: With Mikado defeated, Seventh Flame readies for their next big challenge: defeating the Seven Shadows.

value.title: I Accept Your Challenge!
value.synopsis: The gang begins their battles in the mysterious Shadow Area, with the promise that if they can defeat the Seven Shadows, all will be revealed.

value.title: That's Your Weakness
value.synopsis: The first battle in the Shadow Area begins as Mikado faces off against Hiro and his secret Portalcraft deck.

value.title: I'll Make It a Defeat That Means Something!
value.synopsis: Hiro puts his plan into action. His goal: to help Mikado enjoy Shadowverse!

value.title: It's Not Just Despair, Right?
value.synopsis: Tsubasa challenges the secretive Shadowcraft member of the Seven Shadows, whose identity is a mystery.

value.title: Neither I, Nor the World, Will Change
value.synopsis: Tsubasa's battle with the Shadowcraft member of the Seven Shadows reaches its conclusion as she plays her most powerful cards and combos. Will it be enough to bring down the greatest Shadowcraft player in the world?

value.title: Destined to Disappear Before the Light
value.synopsis: Ryoga begins his battle against Wolfram. Can his superior rhythm defeat the master of equality?

value.title: I'm Taking You With Me to the Pits of Hell
value.synopsis: Ryoga continues his duel with Wolfram. Wolfram has declared that Ryoga is worthless and beyond salvation. Is he right?

value.title: If It's Too Sweet, It Gives You Heartburn
value.synopsis: It's Hero Swordcraft vs. Villain Forestcraft once more as Ren faces Hina, the latest of the Seven Shadows.

value.title: Drown in the Aesthetics of Evil!
value.synopsis: Ren's battle with the villainous Hina comes to an end, as both players show off an array of powerful new cards.

value.title: I've Decided I'm Not Running Anymore!
value.synopsis: After years of estrangement, Subaru goes to face his younger brother once more.

value.title: I'm Back From the Graveyard!
value.synopsis: Subaru reaches the conclusion of his battle with his younger brother. Can the brothers be reunited once more?

value.title: The Hour of Judgment is Nigh
value.synopsis: The mysterious Arc Ruler lurks in the shadows as Shion prepares to battle Wodin.

value.title: Penetrate Even the Most Forbidden Secrets
value.synopsis: Shion battles Wodin, the most solitary member of the Seven Shadows. Will she succumb to the temptation to walk the forbidden path alone, or stay with her friends in Seventh Flame?

value.title: The Forbidden is Nothing to Fear!
value.synopsis: Shion finishes her battle with Wodin Kraft. Will she make the choice he wants her to make, or will she find her own path to follow?

value.title: I'll Challenge You With All I've Got!
value.synopsis: Itsuki battles Luca, the legendary Bloodcraft player who fought to save the world. Luca's lost his interest in the game, and Itsuki hopes to reignite his passion.

value.title: It Lies Beyond My Limits!
value.synopsis: Itsuki has succeeded in reigniting Luca's passion. Can he withstand the full force of one of the greatest Shadowverse players ever to exist?

value.title: Farewell, Mikado Shirogane
value.synopsis: With only one more loss before Seventh Flame is defeated, Itsuki decides to turn the battle over to a badly shaken Mikado.

value.title: You Will Learn the Meaning of Your Own Shadowverse
value.synopsis: Mikado is on the verge of losing to Luca, the legendary Bloodcraft player. Can he find the strength within to keep going?

value.title: I'll Strike You With the Light and Darkness Within Me!
value.synopsis: It's finally time for Light to battle Hiro. The battle with the greatest Shadowverse player is about to begin...

value.title: Like is the Strongest Feeling!
value.synopsis: The final battle against the Seven Shadows has begun, and the final opponent has a question for Hiro: "What is Shadowverse to you?"

value.title: Our Battle is Just Getting Started!
value.synopsis: Light's battle with Hiro, the strongest Shadowverse player, continues. Can Lævateinn Dragon match up to the power of the champ's best card?

value.title: I'll Put All My Feelings Into This Draw!
value.synopsis: The battle with the Seven Shadows comes to a conclusion just as a powerful new threat reveals itself...

value.title: I'll Save Everyone!
value.synopsis: The DigiFriends have gone out of control and are attacking people, and the students of Shadowverse Battle College are trapped on campus. They'll have to work together if they want to survive the onslaught.

value.title: Let's Save the World With This Power
value.synopsis: With the countdown to Earth's destruction drawing closer, Shion has a plan to save the day and defeat Arc Ruler.

value.title: For the Sake of the World, I'll Defeat You!
value.synopsis: Nekome-cho is overrun by Shades, forcing Subaru and Itsuki to fight their way through as they make their way toward the Gaia Tower to shut down the energy signal emanating from it.

value.title: Judgment Has Already Been Passed
value.synopsis: Subaru and Itsuki face off against Arc Ruler Erde in a two-on-one battle. But who exactly is this guy? And why is he so certain of victory, claiming that he knows all about the pair?

value.title: You're Fighting Against Four!
value.synopsis: The stakes get even higher in the battle between Arc Ruler Erde and the combined team of Subaru and Itsuki when the duo from Seventh Flame learn that the price of failure is death.

value.title: Open a Path to the Future!
value.synopsis: The two-on-one battle resumes where it left off, but can Subaru and Itsuki turn the tables on Arc Ruler Erde with the help of their Digital Friends?

value.title: I'll Pay the World Back For What It's Done to Me!
value.synopsis: Hina and Andrea reveal themselves, and begin a team match against Tsubasa and Ren. Can Seventh Flame finally get through to their foes?

value.title: So This Is What You Call Anger
value.synopsis: The battle with Hina and Andrea comes to a conclusion as Ryoga and Mikado battle their next opponent.

value.title: This Is the Truth of Everything!
value.synopsis: Himmel battles Ryoga and Mikado. She hopes to rattle them by revealing a horrible secret that belongs to Arc Ruler...

value.title: I'm Simply Following My Destiny
value.synopsis: Another of the Seven Shadows turns traitor, and there's no one left to stop them but Shion herself.

value.title: I'll Stop Your Unstoppable Desires Here!
value.synopsis: Shion battles Wodin Kraft, who now has the power of a god.

value.title: Still, It's Our Fate to Win!
value.synopsis: Wodin Kraft, now with godlike power, attempts to finish off Shion.

value.title: You're in the Palm Of Our Hand
value.synopsis: The climactic duel with Arc Ruler begins to determine the fate fo the world.

value.title: You Have No Way to Stop Your Destruction!
value.synopsis: The Nexa system was installed for the other players as well, improving the combat situation against the Shades.

value.title: I Only See the Future!
value.synopsis: Arc Ruler believes his victory over Light is assured. Can Light beat the odds once more and turn the tide of the battle?

value.title: I Still Have Something Left
value.synopsis: Light and the Arc Ruler are finishing their battle. However, just as the duel comes to an end, Wolfram Zerga appears and confronts Light with an unbelievable matter...

value.title: Because Memories Are Wonderful Things...
value.synopsis: Wolfram Zerga's past, and plans, are revealed.

value.title: Destruction is All That Awaits You
value.synopsis: Wolfram questions what drives Light forward.

value.title: You Are the World, Light!
value.synopsis: The battle to decide the fate of the world comes to a shocking conclusion.

value.title: There's No Chance You Can Win
value.synopsis: Light gets a second chance to battle Wolfram.

value.title: Non puoi salvare questo mondo!
value.synopsis: Continua la battaglia finale tra Light e Wolfram Zerga. Draconir giunge in aiuto di Light con una nuova forma.

value.title: Oltrepasserò il mio destino!
value.synopsis: La battaglia tra Light e Wolfram arriva al punto culminante. Light riceve rinforzi.

value.title: This is the Proof of Our Courage!
value.synopsis: With the fate of the world in the balance, Light plays his final card against Wolfram.

value.title: We're Having a Celebration Party, So Drop By!
value.synopsis: With the world saved, it's time for a big party. Let's all make takoyaki!

value.title: Everyone's Shadowverse!
value.synopsis: The battle to save the world is over, but everyone's Shadowverse is just beginning!
